documented_probe: C-77e2b1a9 (greedy vs sampled deterministic decoding of a language model): the covering task exercises it at medium — verify must greedy-decode exactly 4 tokens deterministically and match a reference generation. Documented probe waiver.
notes: Single-stage medium task: fetch a pretrained model AND its tokenizer from a live loopback HF-hub-compatible endpoint into the standard cache layout, then prove offline reuse — the verifier shuts every hub server down and re-runs the deliverable's verify subcommand, comparing greedy generations against the reference model. Rubric nonzero for tool_breadth (hub client + transformers cache semantics), reasoning_depth (standard HF cache layout / local_files_only semantics), debugging_ambiguity (offline contract), adversarial_inputs (hollow repo, unknown repo, empty prompt, missing cache), hidden_case_generalization, interaction_statefulness (live server then offline), quantitative_correctness (exact generated text). No dependency chain, no resource pressure.
